en:
It's already nighttime, so please be careful
as you head back to your rooms.
Oh, and...

It's safe to say that Tenko has betrayed
the student council, right?

It's okay, it's okay! I forgive you cuz Atua
forgives you. He's such a softie, y'know.

I hope you will recommit yourself to the student
council and help us make this place our paradise.
Y-Yes...
Nyeh? What's going on?

Why are Shuichi and Maki here? They're not on
the student council. And it's nighttime...
H-Himiko!
Oh, it's nothing.

Tenko simply betrayed the student council
and brought these two to change my mind.
Nyeh!? She betrayed us!?

That sounds like a big problem,
but if you're saying "it's nothing" then...
Angie, you really *are* loved by Atua!
And you are loved by Atua in return, Himiko!
S-Stop it...you're making me blush.
E-Enough already!!!

<CLT=cltMIND>Tenko walked toward Himiko and gripped
her firmly by the shoulders.
Nyeh...?

Please, snap out of it!
Aren't you a mage?
That hurts...let me go...

Himiko, why can't you see that you've
been brainwashed?

If you can't even see that, then...
you're not a real mage at all!
Wh-What...?
Feeling angry? If you are, then show it!

Get mad! Get upset! Yell at me!
Just fight back already! Do something!
Tenko...let's just leave it be for now...

I-I'm so sorry!
I can't believe I just yelled at you!

You must be tired, Tenko. I think it would be
best if you got some rest.

Sound good? Until then, I'll continue my
preparations to welcome back our friend.

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko didn't look Tenko in
the eyes.

<CLT=cltMIND>After leaving Angie's lab, the three of
us returned to the dorms.

<CLT=cltMIND>What is this...? It's like a hanging
scroll, but it's blank.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's usually for when something bad
happens... I hope it stays off.
3F Hallway
